caption:
The video captures a sunny autumn park: a gravel path runs beside a low stone wall lined with tall trees turning golden, while a still lake on the right mirrors the foliage and sky. A couple poses close together near the center, a man in a dark jacket beside a woman in a cream jacket and cap holding a red bag. A woman in a yellow top and a person leaning on the wall stand further left.

Throughout the clip the view slides steadily right, so the central trunk and the row of path trees drift leftward while a large foreground trunk grows more prominent. A new figure seen from behind, with short dark hair and a cream top with a black hood, enters at the bottom-right and expands into the foreground. The lake's reflections and a small floating object move consistently with this rightward shift.

The man in the brown jacket and beige cap, bent over and studying a phone, shifts leftward in frame and becomes partly hidden behind the foreground trunk. The posing couple and the other visitors remain essentially stationary relative to the path, making only small postural adjustments.
